camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeCloudCenterInstances --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 100 --NextToken E17B501887A2D3AA5E8360A6EFA3B000 --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 12324284232340000 --Lang zh --Criteria '[{"name":"riskStatus","value":"YES"},{"name":"internetIp","value":"1.2.XX.XX"}]' --UseNextToken false --Flags '1,2,3' --LogicalExp OR --Importance 2 --CurrentPage 1 --NoGroupTrace false --MachineTypes ecs --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Sets search conditions to perform a conditional query for asset information that matches the specified criteria, such as asset instance name or asset instance region. Both pagination and NextToken methods are supported. The NextToken method is recommended
description_zh: 通过设置搜索条件查询符合条件的资产信息，例如通过资产实例名称、资产实例所属区域等条件搜索指定资产。目前提供分页和NextToken两种方式，推荐NextToken方式
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-cloud-center-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --criteria '[{"name":"riskStatus","value":"YES"},{"name":"internetIp","value":"1.2.XX.XX"}]' --machine-types ecs --logical-exp OR --page-size 100 --current-page 1 --importance 2 --no-group-trace false --lang zh --use-next-token false --next-token E17B501887A2D3AA5E8360A6EFA3B000 --resource-directory-account-id 12324284232340000 --flags 1,2,3 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudCenterInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the instance resides
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的实例所在地域的ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The search conditions for assets. This parameter is in JSON format. Note that the parameter names are case-sensitive.
You can search for assets by instance ID, instance name, VPC ID, region, public IP address, and other conditions. Call the [DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~) operation to query the supported search conditions
parameters.help_zh:
设置搜索资产的条件。该参数JSON格式，输入参数时注意大小写。
支持使用资产的实例ID、实例名称、所属VPC ID、地域、公网IP地址等条件搜索资产。您可以调用[DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~)接口查询支持的搜索条件
parameters.name: criteria

parameters.help_en:
The type of asset to query. Valid values:

ecs: server
cloud_product: cloud product
eci: elastic container instance
rund: RunD container instance
runc: RunC container instance
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的资产的类型。取值：

ecs：服务器
cloud_product：云产品
eci：弹性容器实例
rund：RunD容器实例
runc：RunC容器实例
parameters.name: machine_types

parameters.help_en:
The logical relationship between multiple search conditions. Default value: OR. Valid values:

OR: The search conditions are in an OR relationship.
AND: The search conditions are in an AND relationship
parameters.help_zh:
设置多个搜索条件间生效的逻辑关系。默认OR，取值：

OR：表示多个搜索条件之间是或的关系
AND：表示多个搜索条件之间是与的关系
parameters.name: logical_exp

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的资产的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条资产信息
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the first page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The importance of the asset. Valid values:
2: important asset
1: general asset
0: test asset
parameters.help_zh:
设置资产重要性。取值：
2：重要资产
1：一般资产
0：测试资产
parameters.name: importance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to skip internationalization processing for the default group Ungrouped in Security Center. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: Internationalization processing is skipped. When the value of the GroupTrace response parameter is the Security Center default group Ungrouped, it is displayed as 未分组.
false: Internationalization processing is applied. When the value of the GroupTrace response parameter is the Security Center default group Ungrouped, it is displayed as default
parameters.help_zh:
默认分组未分组是否要做国际化处理。默认false，取值：

true：不做国际化处理。即返回参数GroupTrace的取值为云安全中心的默认分组未分组时，未分组仍然显示为未分组。
false：需要国际化处理。即返回参数GroupTrace的取值为云安全中心的默认分组未分组时，未分组显示为default
parameters.name: no_group_trace

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the NextToken method to retrieve asset list data. If this parameter is set to true, TotalCount is no longer returned. Valid values:

true: Uses the NextToken method.
false: Does not use the NextToken method
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用NextToken方式拉取资产列表数据。如果使用此参数TotalCount不再返回。取值：

true：使用NextToken方式
false：不使用NextToken方式
parameters.name: use_next_token

parameters.help_en: The NextToken value returned when the NextToken method is used. Leave this parameter empty for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 使用NextToken方式下返回的NextToken值。第一次拉取传空
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member accounts in the resource folder.
Invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

parameters.help_en:
The asset vendor. Separate multiple vendors with commas (,). Valid values:

0: Alibaba Cloud asset
1: non-cloud asset
2: IDC asset
3, 4, 5, 7, 14, 16: third-party cloud asset
8: lightweight asset
9: SAE
10: PAI
parameters.help_zh:
资产厂商。多个资产厂商之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

0：阿里云资产
1：云外资产
2：IDC资产
3、4、5、7、14、16：其它云资产
8：轻量级资产
9：SAE
10：PAI
parameters.name: flags
